news.headline: Tulane beats Memphis 31-17
news.summary: Tulane won at home Friday night, 31-17 over Memphis. The defense took the ball away six times, and it is Tulane's first win in conference play this year.

news.headline: TJ Smith runs an interception back for a touchdown
news.summary: Right before halftime, TJ Smith caught a Memphis pass and ran it back 76 yards for a touchdown. That put Tulane ahead 23-10, and it is the first touchdown the Tulane defense has scored this year.

news.headline: Trace Johnson wins his first start
news.summary: Freshman Trace Johnson started at quarterback for the first time and Tulane won. He completed 11 of 21 passes for 165 yards, with a 38-yard touchdown to Destyn Hill and one interception.

nextGame.note: Florida plays Georgia in Atlanta on Halloween afternoon. The Gators are off this coming Saturday, so this is their next game. Georgia has won six games and lost one.

news.headline: Florida beats Texas 27-24
news.summary: Florida was losing 17-3 in the second quarter and then scored 24 points in a row to win in Austin. The Gators are 5-2, and it is their first win at a top-10 team on the road since 2012.

news.headline: Tramell Jones wins his first start for Florida
news.summary: Jones threw two touchdown passes to Lacota Dippre and completed 22 of his 35 throws for 155 yards. He started because Aaron Philo is hurt.

news.headline: Florida's defense sacks Arch Manning five times
news.summary: Florida held Texas under 300 yards and sacked the Texas quarterback five times. The last sack knocked the ball loose and ended Texas's final drive.

nextGame.note: Saturday night home game in Austin. Half past six our time. Ole Miss has won five games and lost one.

news.headline: Texas loses at home to Florida, 27-24
news.summary: Texas led 17-3 in the second quarter and did not score again until the fourth quarter. It is the second loss in a row for the Longhorns, who are now 4-2.

news.headline: Arch Manning has another hard day
news.summary: Manning completed 14 of 20 passes for 173 yards and one touchdown, and Florida sacked him five times. Coach Steve Sarkisian said his team did not play good football.

news.headline: Colin Simmons hurts his ankle
news.summary: Texas's best pass rusher left the game in the fourth quarter with what looked like an ankle injury. The team has not said yet how long he will be out.

nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in New Jersey. The Giants have won three games, lost one and tied one, and they lead their division.

news.headline: Saints get their long snapper back and add a receiver
news.summary: The Saints took long snapper Zach Wood off the injured list on Saturday, so he can play at the Giants. They also moved receiver Cedric Tillman up to the game roster for Sunday.

news.headline: Chris Olave practiced Friday and may play
news.summary: The Saints' best receiver was sick and missed practice Wednesday and Thursday. He took part in some of Friday's practice, and the team lists him as a maybe for Sunday's game at the Giants.

news.headline: Two Saints defenders will miss Sunday's game
news.summary: Linebacker Kaden Elliss has a sore calf and Anfernee Jennings has a hurt knee, and neither one practiced this week. Running back Alvin Kamara is a maybe with a sore back.

news.headline: IUP beats Seton Hill in four sets
news.summary: IUP won at home Friday night by scores of 25-16, 25-21, 21-25 and 25-21. Jessica Neiman led the way with 16 kills, and the Crimson Hawks have now won 16 matches.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher plays her biggest match of the year
news.summary: Peyton had 7 kills on 18 swings with 4 errors in Tuesday night's five-set win at Wheeling, and she added 2 digs and helped block two balls. She played four of the five sets, and those 7 kills are nearly half her total for the whole season.

news.headline: IUP wins in five sets after losing the first two
news.summary: IUP dropped the first two sets at Wheeling on Tuesday night and then won the last three, 25-23, 25-18 and 15-8. Charlotte Potvin led the way with 23 kills, and the Crimson Hawks are now 15-4 with three wins in a row.

news.headline: Three Yankees are up for a Gold Glove
news.summary: Catcher Austin Wells, left fielder Cody Bellinger and Jose Caballero were named finalists for this year's fielding awards on Wednesday. The winners are announced on November 1.

news.headline: Tampa Bay beats the Yankees 4-3 and ends their season
news.summary: Tampa Bay won Wednesday night at Yankee Stadium to take the series three games to none. The Yankees are out of the playoffs, and it is 17 years since they last won the World Series.

news.headline: Aaron Judge says the Yankees should go all in
news.summary: Judge strained a calf in September and watched the whole playoff series from the dugout. He said afterward that the team should go all in and add players for next year.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins a third district game, 22-6
news.summary: The Eagles beat East Jefferson 22-6 on Thursday night in Metairie for their third win in a row. Warren Easton is 3-4 for the year and has won all three of its district games.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins again, 29-6 over Higgins
news.summary: The Eagles beat L.W. Higgins on Thursday night at Pan American Stadium for their second win in a row. Their defense has given up only six points in those two games.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins its first game, 50-0
news.summary: The Eagles shut out Riverdale 50-0 on Thursday in Jefferson for their first win of the year. Warren Easton is now 1-4.
